rationale.hitl-workflow: Defines bounded human authority through operating envelopes, checkpoints, and escalation.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: High-volume probabilistic outputs make meaningful per-item review structurally infeasible.
rationale.oversight-theater: HITL signatures transfer liability without adequate time, evidence, or authority.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Requires external deterministic policy engines, payload checks, and circuit breakers.
rationale.risk-routing: Risk tiers and envelope failures determine automation versus human escalation.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Provenance, intent, constraints, and previews make proposed actions inspectable.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Enforced envelopes and frozen payloads bound unauthorized action and preview drift.
rationale.org-governance: Defines policy ownership, audit logging, procurement guardrails, staffing, and accountability.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Translates EU AI Act and NIST oversight requirements into artifacts.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Immutable evidence receipts persist inputs, versions, policies, and executed payloads.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes default per-item HITL as performative liability transfer.
